description: This file contains C source code implementing UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) context management and configuration handling functions such as init, free, get, set, add, delete, and iterate over sections. It is part of a larger project that manages device configurations and settings.

methods.name: int bbfdm_init_uci_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the UCI context within a given bbfdm context, allocating resources and setting configuration directories if provided.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_uci_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the UCI context in the given bbfdm context.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_buf(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char * buffer,size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified UCI option as a string into a provided buffer, with default fallback.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Obtains a UCI option's value as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_fallback_def(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option's value or its default, similar to bbfdm_uci_get but with a specified fallback default.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_by_section_buf(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * section,const char * option,const char * default_value,char * buffer,size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Fetches a string option from a given UCI section into a buffer, using default if not found.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_get_by_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI string option from a section and returns it as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_set(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a UCI option to a specified value within a package and section, saving the configuration.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_add(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * type,struct uci_section ** s)
methods.description: Adds a new section of a specified type to a UCI package, creating an empty file if necessary.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_delete(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option)
methods.description: Deletes a specific option from a UCI section within a package.

methods.name: int bbfdm_uci_delete_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,struct uci_section * s)
int bbfdm_uci_commit_package(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package)
methods.description: Commits changes to a specified UCI package, making the configuration persistent.

methods.name: struct:uci_section * bbfdm_uci_walk_section(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * package,const char * type,struct uci_section * prev_section)
methods.description: Iterates over sections of a given type within a package, returning the next matching section.
